heading: PROJECTS
description: Selected software projects, zero-knowledge architectures, desktop utilities, and open-source contributions across the Elixpo ecosystem.

projects.name: elixpo-chapter
projects.description: Core multi-product platform architecture and collaborative repositories across the Elixpo ecosystem, contributing to developer tooling, community surfaces, and shared component primitives.

projects.name: Vault-me
projects.description: Local-first zero-knowledge password manager utilizing client-side AES-256-GCM encryption and Argon2id key derivation with cryptographic salt.

projects.name: Stober
projects.description: On-device real-time deepfake detector for browser video calls utilizing facial landmark tracking, eye-blink frequency, lip-sync mismatch, and rPPG pulse verification.

projects.name: Capsker
projects.description: High-performance developer utility tool for rapid visual capture, smart annotations, and asset pipelines designed for swift developer feedback cycles.

projects.name: Paendeo
projects.description: Lightweight Electron-based desktop companion featuring an interactive floating panda animated with real-time 2D physics and idle state behaviors.

projects.name: lixsketch
projects.description: Hand-drawn style infinite whiteboard platform and diagramming suite across the Elixpo ecosystem, powering embeddable visual ideation and canvas rendering.

projects.name: megzo-project
projects.description: Full-stack e-commerce platform application built with modern component architectures, state-driven cart persistence, and responsive product catalog flows.

projects.name: Remener
projects.description: Discord management and operations bot built for developers to automate communications, server workflows, event alerts, and moderation.

projects.name: El
projects.description: An elegant, asset-aware version control system designed from the ground up for indie studios, solo developers, and artists, pairing an intuitive workflow with deep game engine integration.
